text: Illinois Department of Transportation, recognizing its responsibility to protect the environment of the residents of the Village of Park Forest, requested the Village to pass a resolution appropriating $2,250.00 from their Motor Fuel Tax Funds to pay for the cost of the replacement screen plantings. The amount spent by the Village of Park Forest for the planting replacement will be credited against the amount of money due the State of Illinois for modernization of the existing traffic signals at the intersection of Lincoln Highway and Orchard Drive, and the installation of new traffic signals at the intersections of Lincoln Highway at Indiana Street, and at the intersection of Western Avenue with Illinois Street.
